books_reviewed.book: Generative AI Professional Prompt Engineering Guide
Generative AI Prompt Engineering Learning Ecosystem

reading_evidence.note: Review uses verified public anchors recorded in the catalog.

item_reviews.title: When an agent says it is done, grade the database
item_reviews.reader_value: Connect conversational completion claims to durable-state verification, repeatable regression checks, explicit evaluation and a reusable checking workflow.

item_reviews.title: Copilot steps beyond APIs into desktop apps
item_reviews.reader_value: Desktop actions make bounded context, structured handoffs, clarification before ambiguous actions and clear human-versus-agent roles especially useful.

item_reviews.title: Gemini puts study workflows in one hub
item_reviews.reader_value: A study hub is more useful when learners calibrate trust, supply strong context, frame requests clearly and combine multiple learning resources.

item_reviews.title: Workspace turns prompts into images, mini-apps and cross-app work
item_reviews.reader_value: Cross-app work benefits from current-state data, structured handoffs, clear prompts and reusable editable artifacts that preserve intent.

item_reviews.title: NVIDIA gives agents a verified DOCA skill set
item_reviews.reader_value: A reusable skill is a structured contract; these sections help readers understand why instructions, references, constraints and reusable templates must stay coherent.

item_reviews.title: Ambient agents wake up on events — and know when to ask a human
item_reviews.reader_value: Event-driven autonomy needs clear exception handling, escalation playbooks, clarification paths and role boundaries so a human can take over at the right point.
